name: localcut-desktop
description: LocalCut AI desktop shell — Electron + React frontend for the LocalCut engine

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && tsc -p electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build: tsc -p electron && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p electron --noEmit && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.package: npm run check:engine -- win && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:dir: npm run check:engine -- win && npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.package:linux: npm run check:engine -- linux && npm run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.package:linux:dir: npm run check:engine -- linux && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --dir
scripts.package:mac: npm run check:engine -- mac-arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.package:mac:dir: npm run check:engine -- mac-arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir
scripts.rig:gate: npm run build && npm run rig:walk && npm run rig:e2e
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run check:engine -- mac-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64

author: Hanzla Mateen <hanzlamateen@live.com>
